name: Arch
description: Arch is a pay-per-call theological review of writing against Scripture. Local stdio server from tnvolman/arch-cursor-plugin. Guard matches only the executable basename arch-mcp. arch_review POSTs to https://arch.tnvolman.com/v1/review and sends ARCH_API_KEY as X-API-Key. kjv_lookup is local and sends nothing. Logs and provider copies are kept no more than 30 days, except where a provider's terms require longer. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Set the MCP command to an executable named arch-mcp. Guard matches only that basename. Published mcp.json uses node ./server/index.mjs, which is not matched. At eaf99bbc server/index.mjs is mode 100644. No PRIVACY.md.

Node v22.23.4 (undici 6.29.1) https fetch adds user-agent node, accept-language *, sec-fetch-mode cors, accept-encoding br, gzip, deflate, host, content-length, and connection keep-alive, besides the plugin headers. Other Node 18+ versions are unverified.

arch_review only POSTs JSON {text, max_tokens?, payment_method_id?, idempotency_key?} to https://arch.tnvolman.com/v1/review. Code sets Content-Type, Accept, X-API-Key (the ARCH_API_KEY value), and Idempotency-Key when idempotency_key is non-empty.

If ARCH_API_KEY is missing or empty, or text is empty or over 50000 characters, arch_review sends nothing. kjv_lookup only reads bundled server/data/kjv.json and sends no reference, verse text, or API key.

Plugin stores neither text nor the key. Privacy page (19 Oct 2026): text is sent to Anthropic, held in memory, not stored. Call count, last-used, and charge rows (intent id, amount, currency, status, char count; not the text) stay until deleted on request.

the-forge 06544142 arch.py:264 logs email and key_prefix (first 12 chars). :338 and :570 log character count. :939 stores an 8-char prefix and a hash. No reviewed log writes the full X-API-Key. Exceptions at :206, :368, and :620 are unverified.
Commercial terms: "Anthropic may not train models on Customer Content from Services."

Logs and provider copies are kept no more than 30 days, except where a provider's terms require longer (for example Anthropic safety review or legal holds). Anthropic: 30 days (7996866). Railway Hobby/Pro: up to 30 days. Cloudflare: up to 7 days.
